files.extent: Complete 740-line source fetched from the immutable upstream commit, checked against its Git blob and SHA-256, and read end-to-end. Semantic notes are scoped to map-header pointer and generated-include emission.
source_observations: generate_map_header_text emits a 32-bit map-script pointer to either the configured shared_scripts_map label or the current map's _MapScripts label; it does not emit the script records themselves.
generate_headers_text includes each map's generated header.inc in map-group order, while generate_groups_text emits the map-group pointer arrays and gMapGroups table.

The generated header's _MapScripts target is a symbol contract with separately authored script assembly; this source does not validate that the target label exists or that the referenced table is well formed.
